album.description: Album mode for string input and string lines in list files.

album-art.description: Retrieve additional images after downloading the album: 'default': No additional images 'largest': Download from the folder with the largest image 'most': Download from the folder containing the most images

album-art-only.description: Only download album art for the provided album; implies album-art=largest when album-art is default

album-track-count.description: Specify the exact number of tracks in the album. Add a + or - for inequalities, e.g '5+' for five or more tracks. Spotify/Bandcamp inputs automatically set album-track-count to n+.

album-track-count-max-retries.description: Max retries when album track count fails (default: 5)

allowed-users.description: Users to allow, comma-separated. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

artist-maybe-wrong.description: Performs an additional search without the artist name. Useful for sources like SoundCloud where the "artist" could just be an uploader. Note that when downloading a YouTube playlist via URL, this option is set automatically on a per-track basis, so it is best kept off in that case.

banned-users.description: Users to ignore, comma-separated. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

browse-folder.description: Automatically browse user shares to get all files in the selected album folder (default)

chat-room.description: Join these rooms on connect. Separate names with commas. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

connect-timeout.description: Timeout used when logging in to Soulseek (default: 20000ms)

detach.description: Submit a download, print its workflow ID and exit

exclude-locked.description: Exclude locked files from search results (default: false)

extract-artist.description: Extract artist/title from titles like "Artist - Title"

extract-max-track-count.description: Set maximum album track count from extracted sources

fails-to-downrank.description: Failures within a workflow before downranking a peer (default: 2)

fails-to-ignore.description: Failures within a workflow before ignoring a peer (default: 3)

fallback-level.description: Try simpler searches when no results are found. 0: normal searches only 1: retry with the first artist, without feat./ft. credits 2: also try each remaining artist (default) 3: also try broader searches for artist/album/title only and relax length requirements.

fast-search.description: Begin downloading as soon as a file satisfying the preferred conditions is found. Only for song downloads.

fast-search-min-up-speed.description: Minimum upload speed for fast-search candidates (default: 1)

format.description: Required file format(s). Comma-separated, unordered. See also --pref-format for soft preferences. Prefix with '+ ' to append.

from-html.description: Read Bandcamp page HTML from a local file

get-deleted.description: Attempt to retrieve titles of deleted videos from wayback machine. Requires yt-dlp.

group.description: Group download mode: Find and download all distinct songs associated with the provided artist, album, or title.

group-length-tol.description: Max length tolerance in seconds to consider two tracks or albums equal. (Default: 3)

incomplete-album-action.description: What to do with completed album files when the album does not complete. Values: 'move' to move to {configured output dir}/failed (default), 'move:<path>' to move to a custom path, 'delete' to delete them, or 'keep' to leave them where they are.

index-path.description: Override default path for Sockseek index

invalid-replace-str.description: Replacement string for invalid path characters (default: space)

length-tol.description: Length tolerance in seconds, -1 to disable (default: -1)

log-file.description: Write debug logs to a file

max-album-track-count.description: Maximum number of tracks in an album folder

max-fallback-attempts.description: Maximum fallback searches when no results are found (def: 8)

max-stale-time.description: Max download time without progress in ms (default: 30000). Files you pick in Search or peer Shares can wait longer if the peer confirms they’re still queued.

min-album-track-count.description: Minimum number of tracks in an album folder

min-group-shares.description: Minimum number of shares of a track or album for it to be downloaded in group mode. (Default: 2)

mock-files-dir.description: Directory containing files to simulate download results

mock-files-no-read-tags.description: Only read filenames when simulating (much faster)

mock-files-slow.description: Simulate slow mock-file downloads and folder browses

monitor.description: Monitor all active workflows until interrupted Supply an input to submit it and monitor all daemon work

name-format.description: Name format for downloaded tracks. See `--help name-format`

no-browse-folder.description: Do not automatically browse user shares to get all files in the folder

no-docs.description: Disable the bundled manual at /docs/ (requires restart)

no-incomplete-ext.description: Write directly to the destination during download.

no-progress.description: Disable progress bars/percentages, only simple printing

no-remove-special-chars.description: Keep special characters in Soulseek search terms

no-skip-existing.description: Download items even when index/file checks find an existing match

no-write-index.description: Do not create/update the Sockseek index

number.description: Download the first n tracks of a playlist

offset.description: Skip a specified number of tracks

on-complete.description: Run a command when a download completes. See `--help on-complete`

parse-title.description: Parse title fields with placeholders like {artist} - {title}

password-file.description: Read the Soulseek password from a file

playlist-path.description: Override default path for m3u playlist file

pref-allowed-users.description: Users to prefer, comma-separated. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

pref-banned-users.description: Users to downrank, comma-separated. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

pref-format.description: Preferred format(s) for ranking. Use --format to require formats strictly. Comma-separated, unordered. Prefix with '+ ' to append.

pref-strict-album.description: Prefer folder paths containing album name

pref-strict-artist.description: Prefer file paths containing artist name

pref-strict-title.description: Prefer filenames containing the track title

print.description: Print jobs or search results instead of downloading: 'jobs': Print input jobs after extraction/preprocessing 'jobs-full': Print extended information about input jobs 'results': Print search results satisfying file conditions 'results-full': Print search results including full paths. 'json': Print first result in json format 'json-all': Print json of all results in sorted order 'link': Print first result slsk:// link 'index': Print Sockseek index as formatted json 'index-failed': Print failed downloads from Sockseek index

private-message-blocked-user.description: Discard private messages from these users. Separate names with commas. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

progress-json.description: Print progress events as JSON lines

regex.description: Remove a regexp from all track titles and artist names. Optionally specify a replacement regex after a semicolon. Add 'T:', 'A:' or 'L:' at the start to only apply this to the track title, artist, or album respectively. Prefix with '+ ' to append a regex rule instead of replacing prior rules.

relax-filtering.description: Slightly relax file filtering in group mode to include more results

remote.description: Connect to the daemon at this URL (required unless configured)

remote-api-key-file.description: Read the API key from a file (preferred)

remove-brackets.description: Remove square-bracketed text from track titles before search

remove-from-source.description: Remove downloaded tracks from source CSV file

remove-ft.description: Remove 'feat.' and everything after before searching

response-limit.description: Max accepted peer responses per search attempt (default: 250)

search-timeout.description: Stop a search attempt after this long without an accepted response (default: 5000 for CLI jobs, 15000 for webui searches)

searches-per-time.description: Max searches per time interval. Higher values may cause 30-minute bans, see `--help notes`. (default: 34)

searches-renew-time.description: Controls how often available searches are replenished. See `--help notes`. (default: 220)

server-ip.description: IP/interface for the daemon HTTP API (default: 127.0.0.1)

server-port.description: Port for the daemon HTTP API (default: 5030)

share.description: Share a local directory, optionally under an alias. The share root may be a symlink. Prefix with '+ ' to append.

share-exclude.description: Exclude a local directory and its contents from shares. Prefix with '+ ' to append.

share-filter.description: Exclude files and directories whose remote relative paths match the pattern (case-insensitive). Prefix with '+ ' to append.

share-rescan-interval.description: Periodic rescan interval (for example 30m, 12h, or off; default: off)

share-scan-on-start.description: Scan configured shares when the daemon starts (default: true)

share-search-result-limit.description: Max files sent per peer search reply (default: 500, 0 disables replies)

skip-check-cond.description: Check file conditions when skipping existing files. If the local candidate does not exist or does not satisfy the required conditions, the item will not be skipped.

skip-check-pref-cond.description: Check preferred conditions when skipping existing files

skip-mode-music-dir.description: How to match files in --skip-music-dir: name|tag (default: name)

skip-mode-output-dir.description: How to match files in the output dir: name|tag|index (default: index)

skip-music-dir.description: Also skip downloading tracks found in a music library

skip-not-found.description: Skip searching for tracks that weren't found on Soulseek during the last run.

spotify-secret-file.description: Read the Spotify client secret from a file

strict-album-quality.description: Require every audio file in an album folder to satisfy required quality conditions such as --format, bitrate, sample rate, and bit depth. By default mixed-quality folders are ranked by coverage.

strict-artist.description: Require artist in path. When the input artist contains multiple artists split by ;, requires one only.

strict-conditions.description: Skip files with missing properties instead of accepting by default; if --min-bitrate is set, ignores any files with unknown bitrate. Warning: Available props depend on client

time-format.description: Time format in Length column of the CSV file (e.g h:m:s.ms for durations like 1:04:35.123). Default: s

transfer-retention-days.description: Transfer history, attempts and byte accounting retention (default: forever)

trusted-proxies.description: Forwarding proxy IPs, comma-separated (default: 127.0.0.1,::1). Prefix with '+ ' to append one address.

unsuccessful-job-retention-days.description: Failed, cancelled, and interrupted job retention (default: forever)

upgrade-to-album.description: Upgrade song-shaped sources such as CSV song rows or Spotify playlist tracks into album jobs when possible.

upload-blocked-ip.description: Block access to your shares from these comma-separated IP addresses. Prefix with '+ ' to append one address.

upload-blocked-user.description: Block these users' access to your shares. Separate names with commas. Prefix with '+ ' to append one exact name.

upload-speed-limit-kib.description: Aggregate upload limit in KiB/s (default: unlimited)

web-password-file.description: WebUI password file (required unless a hash or --no-auth is set)

web-password-hash.description: WebUI password hash generated by sockseek auth hash-password

write-index.description: Create/update the Sockseek index (default when using compatible inputs)

write-playlist.description: Create an m3u playlist file in the output directory

youtube-key-file.description: Read the YouTube Data API key from a file

yt-dlp.description: Use yt-dlp to download songs that weren't found on Soulseek. yt-dlp must be available from the command line. Works on any input containing songs; albums not supported. Runs a YouTube search and downloads the first result. For YouTube inputs, downloads directly by ID instead.

yt-dlp-argument.description: The command line arguments when running yt-dlp. Default: "{id}" -f bestaudio/best -o "{savepath-noext}.%(ext)s" -x Available vars are: {id}, {savedir}, {savepath}, {savepath-noext}. Note that -x causes yt-dlp to download webms in case ffmpeg is unavailable.

yt-parse.description: Enable if the CSV contains YouTube video titles and channel names; attempt to parse them into title and artist names.
